inference_interface.future_index: exact target timestamps inherited from frozen #81 split
inference_interface.authority_resolution: PR #100 moves these already-frozen values into config/models.json#models.kronos_mini.inference and the adapter consumes that authority.

inputs.source_grain: one row per trade_date and contract_id
inputs.index_rule: strictly increasing and unique after explicit timezone normalization; no implicit localization or timestamp substitution
inputs.continuous_series_rule: derive from raw per-contract rows using the active authoritative roll policy; no stored price adjustment and no cross-contract return construction
inputs.contract_trace_rule: contract_id, expiration and available_at remain in the input manifest for every adapter row even though only OHLCV values are passed to Kronos
inputs.context_window_rule: for each prediction cutoff use the most recent min(512, N) PIT-eligible rows from the frozen #81 market series, where N is the number available at that cutoff
inputs.short_history_rule: use all PIT-eligible rows when N < 512; if the pinned adapter/checkpoint rejects that deterministic context, the run fails rather than changing the window
inputs.missing_value_rule: no imputation, forward fill, interpolation or silent row dropping; any missing/non-finite adapter value in a selected context blocks that run
inputs.ohlcv_validation: open/high/low/close must be finite and positive; high >= max(open, close, low); low <= min(open, close, high); volume must be finite and >= 0
inputs.pit_rule: Every source row must be knowable at or before the frozen #81 information cutoff for that prediction; later rows are prohibited.
inputs.resolution: inherit dataset/vintage/OOS/PIT/timezone exactly from corrected frozen #81; validate schema and roll semantics against their authoritative owners

target_and_split.permitted_target_mapping: Only the frozen target_ret_1 at one trading session is accepted: log(predicted_close_next / observed_close_at_cutoff), with cross-contract target returns prohibited.

comparator.selection_rule: exact strongest comparable V1 control frozen by #81 under #78 comparability rules

seed_semantics.replay_requirement: prediction artifact SHA-256 must equal the primary prediction artifact SHA-256

stop_failure_rules: block until corrected #81 binds this exact preparation revision and exact separate implementation revision and #88 passes
block if any inherited #81 hard-context, comparator, metric, threshold or review identity is unresolved or mismatched
block if checkpoint/tokenizer/config identity differs from the preregistered snapshot
block if pinned model/tokenizer artifacts are not locally resolvable and hash-verified before the measured run
stop if input schema, PIT cutoff, ordering, uniqueness, finiteness or coverage is invalid
stop on a cross-contract target return
stop if runtime exceeds the compute cap
stop if output timestamps/schema are invalid or any governed prediction is non-finite
stop if primary and exact-replay prediction hashes differ
stop if governed artifact hashing or manifest completion fails
preserve negative/null/inferior results without checkpoint, seed, sampling, horizon, input, model-family or feature rescue search
release_rule: Only #88 PASS over the corrected exact frozen #81 record and its bound child revisions may release #82 empirically.
preparation_complete_when: exact pinned checkpoint hashes have passed a non-empirical preflight
exact implementation revision is separately published
